recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Revisit only if a future PA decision intentionally adds a gender or sex-related field to ExtendedContactDetail or a replacement Organization contact structure.
issue_request: FHIR-5417 asked to remove Organization.contact.gender because including gender for an Organization contact seemed arbitrary; the Published/Persuasive resolution states that the gender property was removed from the organization contact.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-5417-tagged implementation commit was found. Historical Organization spreadsheet source contained Organization.contact.gender, but the maintained current Organization StructureDefinition introduced by the 2021 source rework and present at HEAD does not include that element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Organization as an active current-build resource. Organization.contact is now typed as ExtendedContactDetail, and that active datatype source defines purpose, name, telecom, address, organization, and period without gender. Exact Confluence Jira-reference search found no FHIR-5417 page, and broad community searches did not reveal a conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already satisfies the requested removal and no authoritative source hunk is needed.
